capability.summary: Inspect an image's format, dimensions, and color mode
capability.description: Opens one image with Pillow and returns its detected format, pixel dimensions, and mode; the operation argument is only echoed and no image transformation is performed.
capability.problem_space: Lightweight metadata inspection for a single Pillow-readable image file.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: image path and operation string; output: JSON echoing operation with image format, two-element size, and mode metadata.
accepted_inputs: a readable image file format recognized by the installed Pillow plugins
any operation string, which is echoed but does not alter behavior
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.pillow_transform", operation as the echoed string, format as Pillow's detected format string or null, size as the serialized [width, height] pair, and mode as the image mode string. A caught file-open or image-identification exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.pillow_transform", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: does not resize, crop, filter, convert, save, or otherwise transform the image despite the wrapper name and original label
the operation argument is ignored for processing and only echoed; a missing value defaults to info
returns metadata in JSON rather than an image artifact even though the manifest artifact_type remains structurally unchanged
does not explicitly call load or verify, so inspection may not detect every corruption located beyond the image header
missing, unreadable, and unrecognized image files use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: JSON-wrapped image metadata: echoed operation, detected format, pixel size, and color mode; no transformed image is produced.

intent_tags: identify an image format with Pillow
negative_intents: resize crop or filter an image
convert or save an image in another format
validate every pixel or fully decode image content

output_contract.description: JSON-wrapped image metadata: echoed operation, detected format, pixel size, and color mode; no transformed image is produced.
